name: Linear Instead of Exponential Backoff
description: compute_delay calculates delay linearly (base_delay * attempt) instead of exponentially (base_delay * (2 ** attempt)).
valid_search_block:
# Defect: linear multiplier used instead of exponential progression
        calculated_delay = self.base_delay * attempt
valid_replace_block:
# Fixed: exponential progression
        calculated_delay = self.base_delay * (2 ** attempt)
out_of_scope_replace_block:
def compute_delay(self, attempt: int) -> float:
        return self.base_delay * (2 ** attempt)
